title: Defrosting the Born-Infeld dyonic frozen star with tachyon matter: spectrum of oscillations
summary: The frozen star is a model for the interior of an astrophysical black hole that is externally indistinguishable from the singular geometry of a Schwarzschild black hole, even though it contains no singularities nor trapped surfaces. The frozen star corresponds to a macroscopic ``BIon'', a solution of a certain type of Born-Infeld Lagrangian coupled to Einstein gravity, which consists of rigid flux tubes sourced by an electric charge localized at its center and a uniform distribution of opposite charge along its outer surface.
